articles.summary: Like many leaders who come from technical backgrounds, I spent years developing expertise and finding answers, helping different teams overcome challenges. Being the person with the solution was how I created value. When I became a manager, I assumed I was empowering my team because I delegated work. Looking back, I realize I was missing a critical piece of leadership.
articles.title: The Hardest Pivot in My Career: Moving from Subject Matter Expert to Developer of People

articles.summary: Over the past year, our AI Champion network has grown into a community of employees representing functions across Advanced Surgery. From technical writing and software engineering to systems engineering, design assurance, quality, and many other disciplines, employees are finding practical ways to use AI to work more efficiently and focus their expertise where it creates the greatest value.
articles.title: How AI Champions Are Accelerating Innovation Across Advanced Surgery

articles.summary: During our Bedford Employee Appreciation Day, I was reminded that all of those outcomes begin with people. The goal for this year's event was straightforward. We wanted employees to have an opportunity to step away from their daily responsibilities and enjoy being part of the broader Bedford community. While we collaborate every day, we don't always have opportunities to get to know one another beyond projects and meetings.
articles.title: Why Employee Appreciation Matters More Than Ever
